objective: Confirmar de donde obtiene SoftRestaurant CIENFUEGOS el tipo de cambio para la forma de pago 03 DOLARES USA. R52 demostro que folios 104124 y 104623 quedan cortos exactamente por 600 y 150 al sumar cp.importe sin convertir; 40 USD y 10 USD requieren una equivalencia efectiva de 16 MXN/USD para cuadrar. No hardcodear 16: localizar campo o tabla fuente de moneda/tipo de cambio y evidencia de esos dos pagos. No modificar Cuentas, Comandas, codigo, datos ni Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_currency_related_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (TABLE_NAME IN ('chequespagos','formasdepago','cheques') OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%moneda%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%cambio%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%divisa%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%dolar%') AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%moneda%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%cambio%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%dolar%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%divisa%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%factor%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%valor%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%tipo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%importe%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: cienfuegos_currency_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND (TABLE_NAME LIKE '%moneda%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%cambio%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%divisa%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%dolar%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%tipo%cambio%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

queries.name: cienfuegos_gap_ticket_payment_full_rows
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM chequespagos WHERE folio IN ('104124','104623') ORDER BY folio,idformadepago

queries.name: cienfuegos_gap_usd_implied_exchange_rate
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio, CAST(ch.total AS decimal(18,4)) AS total_cheque, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.idformadepago<>'03' THEN ISNULL(cp.importe,0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,4)) AS pagos_mxn, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.idformadepago='03' THEN ISNULL(cp.importe,0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,4)) AS usd_nominal, CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cp.idformadepago='03' THEN ISNULL(cp.importe,0) ELSE 0 END)<>0 THEN (ch.total-SUM(CASE WHEN cp.idformadepago<>'03' THEN ISNULL(cp.importe,0) ELSE 0 END))/SUM(CASE WHEN cp.idformadepago='03' THEN ISNULL(cp.importe,0) ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS decimal(18,4)) AS tipo_cambio_implicito FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN chequespagos cp ON cp.folio=ch.folio WHERE ch.folio IN ('104124','104623') GROUP BY ch.folio,ch.total ORDER BY ch.folio
